root_cause.text: `ext4_mb_find_by_goal()` immediately propagates the error returned by `ext4_mb_load_buddy()` when a block group's bitmap is corrupted, preventing the allocator from skipping the corrupted group and attempting allocation in other groups.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (EXT4_MB_GRP_BBITMAP_CORRUPT(e4b->bd_info) && !(ac->ac_flags & EXT4_MB_HINT_GOAL_ONLY))` when `ext4_mb_load_buddy()` returns an error, returning 0 instead of the error to allow the allocation process to continue with other block groups.

intent_record.how: Returns 0 instead of an error when buddy loading fails due to a corrupt bitmap, allowing the allocator to try other block groups if it is not restricted to the goal group.
